tasks.instructions: Experiment E1 (tests H35): Fused conv -> tcgen05 GEMM1 -> exact GELU -> GRN stats pass for the HW >= 1024 rows (64,96; 32,128; 8,320), plus GRN-scale launch and batched swap-AB cuBLASLt GEMM2 writing NCHW. Rows: 64,96,112,112 and 32,128,64,64 first, 8,320,32,32 and 4,96,56,56 as stretch; every other row runs the r0 fallback (merge-only candidate). Lineage isolation: you may read only the r0 baseline; the notebook holds the validated tcgen05 facts you need (r6 D: MN-major SW128 B descriptor LBO 8192 / SBO 1024 / +2048 per k16, instruction-descriptor bits, 1SM landing cap 68-92 B/clk/SM, per-stage floor ~480 clk at N=128, STACK-frame pitfall, stamps only from working warps; r2 A: TMA 3-D box inner start must be a multiple of 16 B, so start the halo box at w=-4 with width W+8). STEP 0 (gate, <= 1/4 of the session): a single-CTA fused tile for the 64,96 geometry. 4-8 conv warps consume a TMA 3-D box ring of x over channel groups of 16-32 (tile = 2 or 4 image rows x 112 columns plus the 6-row halo; try 4 rows if smem allows, it halves the staging redundancy), compute the 7x7 depthwise conv with the 49 taps in registers and per-token sum/sumsq, and write fp16 d as [c][token] into a 128B-swizzled smem B tile (C x 224 or 448 tokens). One MMA warp runs kind::f16 128 x N x 96 for each of the 3 hidden M-tiles with W1' (384 x 96 fp16 = 74 KB, folded with lnw) resident in smem, two TMEM accumulators ping-pong (2 x 224 columns). 4 epilogue warps: tcgen05.ld, LN fold rs*(acc - mu*u[k]) + v[k] (lane = k, per-token mu/rs from smem), exact erf GELU where half of each thread's elements use an FMA-only minimax odd polynomial (|err| <= 5e-7 on [-4,4], clamped beyond) and half the ex2/rcp A&S-style form, square-accumulate per (image,k) in registers, fp16 h stores staged through smem for 16-B coalesced [k][token] or [token][k] writes (pick the layout GEMM2 wants). Validate the tile against torch (fp32 reference, max err <= 2e-5 before fp16 rounding of h; the erf forms against erff to 5e-7). Measure clk per tile for conv-only, epilogue-only, MMA-only and full; the SIMT bound per 224-token tile is ~8.2k clk conv + ~13.4k clk GELU (20 instr/element) or ~7k with the balanced erf. GO if the full tile is <= 1.5x (conv + epilogue) bound; if it is >= 2x, stop and report where the cycles go (LDS, issue, TMEM loads). If the tcgen05 descriptor work is not correct after 1/3 of the session, fall back to mma.sync m16n8k16 for GEMM1 in the same fused structure (the hypothesis is the fusion, not the engine; mma.sync costs ~130 us of tensor time at 64,96 that overlaps the SIMT work). STEP 1: persistent pass-1 kernel (1 CTA/SM, 148 CTAs, static tile loop over (image, row-block) tiles; per-(image,k) sumsq via one red.global.add.f32 per tile per k; hidden fp16 to a torch.empty scratch; stamps from the working warps for conv wait, MMA, epilogue per tile). At C=128 (32,128) W1' is 128 KB: stream it per M-tile through a TMA ring (32 KB per 128 x 128 tile) or hold two of the four M-tiles; at C=320 (8,320) stream it. STEP 2: pass 2. K3' = one plain launch: per image s_b[k] = 1 + gw[k] * gf[b][k] / (mean_k gf[b] + eps) from the sums, fp16 W2_b = fp16(W2 * s_b) per image (C x 4C per image: 74 KB at C=96, 4.7 MB total at 64,96), b2' = W2.gb + b2 in fp32 as hi/lo fp16 K-augmentation columns or an fp32 bias; then cuBLASLt batched swap-AB GEMM2: D_b[C x HW] = W2_b * h_b^T + x_b (C operand = x_b, beta 1, batch = images, fp32 D written straight into the NCHW output). F found this form 2-4 us faster than channels-last + transpose at HW=784 and fine above; if cuBLASLt picks a slow kernel for 64 batches, fall back to channels-last GEMM2 plus a transpose-add kernel. Three launches total. STEP 3: run_tests all 16 rows (portal-order check), interleaved x3 with r6-merge in the same container (that is the control: A r5 1027 / 259 / 78.6 us at 64,96 / 32,128 / 8,320). Report per-launch times (pass 1, K3', GEMM2) and the pass-1 stamps. STEP 4: precision log (fp64 reference, harness generators, seed 200, 10 rounds) for every shipped row: max |err| and beyond-own-atol count; roundings are d16, fp16(W1'), h16, fp16(W2_b): the same set A ships, plus the per-image W2 scaling, which rounds s_b*W2 once (relative 2^-11, same as fp16(W2)). Record SASS STACK/LDL counts for the pass-1 kernel. Record findings in the card: tile clk breakdown, erf split speed vs erff, staging redundancy chosen, cuBLASLt batched G2 time at 64 and 32 batches. Success: run_tests 16/16 with the gate met; 64,96 <= 750 us and 32,128 <= 190 us rented in the same container as r6-merge (1027 / 259), pass 1 alone <= 450 / 110 us, 0 beyond-own-atol elements over 10 seeded rounds on every shipped row. Stretch: 8,320 <= 60. Refuted if: The gate tile runs >= 2x the SIMT bound with no identified removable term, or pass 1 alone is >= K1 + G1 + K2 of A (825 us at 64,96 or 205 at 32,128) in the same container, or any shipped row has a beyond-atol element that the hi/lo split of W2_b does not fix. This is an EXPLORATION task: the goal is to learn whether this idea can move some size band by 3% or more on the portal, not to edge out the current best by 0.1%. You may discard the parent's design entirely; it is given for reference. Test the idea's core assumption with probe_b200 first (seconds per probe). If the idea does not pan out, still return your best version of it as the candidate and record what you learned in the card's findings: negative results are valuable and go into the lab notebook for later rounds. CUDA C++ uses the two-file layout. Set the card's tests: field to the hypothesis id(s). OPERATOR NOTE (rules): (1) torch.empty memory is uninitialised: the per-(image,k) sumsq accumulators (and any other red.add target) must be zeroed in this call before the first red.add (a zero pass inside an earlier kernel of this call, cudaMemsetAsync on the current stream, or per-tile partials reduced in K3' with no atomics); never rely on a previous call's state. (2) cuBLASLt plans may be shape-keyed, but every pointer on a matmul descriptor (bias, epilogue aux) and the batched pointers/strides must be set on every call. (3) No PDL; stamps compiled out of the shipped build (the timed path writes no stamp buffer).

Experiment E2 (tests H34): Port D's single-launch tcgen05 skeleton to the lowest-scoring S/M rows: 1,192 / 4,192 / 8,192 (28x28), 2,96 (56x56) and 1,160 (449x7), wide-C rows unchanged. Keep the six wide-C rows on the r6 code path bit-identical (same tile tables); add a small-C path and a shape dispatch; rows not covered run the r0 fallback (merge-only candidate). STEP 0: interleave r6-merge in your container as the control (its paths: B coop at 1,192 29.5-30.8 rented, A r5 at 4,192 34.0, 8,192 46.1, 2,96 36.8, 1,160 39.6) and stamp the r6 kernel at 2,768 with globaltimer from the working warps (phase A end, sync 1 release, GEMM1 mainloop end, GEMM1 epilogue end, sync 2 release, GEMM2 end, red end): that is the chain budget the small-C rows inherit (27.6 us with phase A 7.4). STEP 1, conv: bulk-plane units for 28x28 planes (3136 B, 16-B multiple; 32 planes = 100 KB per unit, thread per 7-output row segment: 4 segments x 28 rows = 112 threads per plane) and 56x56 planes (12544 B; 8 planes per unit with zero-padded 62x62 slots, 8 segments x 56 rows = 448 threads per plane); for 449x7 the planes are 12572 B (not a multiple of 16): bulk-copy the 16-B-aligned superset [align_down(start), align_up(end)) into a slot and read the conv input at offset (start mod 16) bytes; W=7 rows use whole-row strips with compile-time tap masks. Per-token LN sum/sumsq across channel units as the r6 code does for 7x7 (atomics or a per-token second pass); the fp16 weight conversion (W1' = lnw-folded W1 and u, W2, b2' = W2.gb + b2) spread over all CTAs as one pass (1.2 MB at C=192); out prefilled with x + b2' in phase A where split-K is used. STEP 2, GEMM1 tiles: swap-AB A = 128 hidden-row tiles of W1' (6 at C=192, 3 at C=96, 5 at C=160), B = d16 [C][N tokens] MN-major SW128, N = 112 or 128-token chunks of one image (784 = 7 x 112; 3136 = 28 x 112; 3143 -> 29 x 112 with the last chunk padded, pad columns masked out of the sumsq as the HWS padding is today); per-(image,k) sumsq by one red.global.add.f32 per (image,k) per tile since chunks of one image now span tiles; persistent loop over tiles (42 / 168 / 336 / 168 / 145 tiles). Keep the epilogue register-resident (check cuobjdump STACK = 0) and size N so that the per-tile post-accumulator phase is <= 2 us. STEP 3, GEMM2: M = C as a 128-row tile plus a 64-row tile at C=192 (UMMA M=64 is legal for 1SM; or 128 with masking), M=96 -> 128 padded at C=96, M=160 -> 128 + 32-padded-to-64 at C=160; N = the same token chunks; K = 4C split KS so that CTA count >= 148 with k-slices of >= 128 (1,192: 2 x 7 x KS); keep the two-accumulator (h and g) GRN form; coalesced red.global.add.v4 into the prefilled output, which is NCHW-natural because the tile is [c][tokens] with tokens contiguous per image row... for 28x28 and 56x56 images the token index is h*W + w, so the [c][token] tile maps straight onto x[b][c][:, :] rows. STEP 4: run_tests 16/16 (portal-order check), interleaved x3 with r6-merge; report per-row times, the stamps at 1,192 and 2,768, and the wide-C rows unchanged within noise. STEP 5: precision log (fp64 reference, harness generators, seed 200, 10 rounds) for every new path (max |err|, beyond-own-atol count; 1,192 has the tightest atol 2.4e-3). Also log the B paths of r6-merge (1,192; 1,96) if time allows, since they are owed. Do not start the cta_group::2 pair port in this session; if the small-C port finishes early, use the time to stamp and shrink the 1,192 chain (dependent rounds after each sync, conv tail). Success: run_tests 16/16; 1,192 <= 24 us rented and at least 4 us under the r6-merge path on 3 of the 5 target rows (1,192; 4,192; 8,192; 2,96; 1,160) in the same container; wide-C rows within 1 us of r6-d-e2-epi-fix; 0 beyond-own-atol elements over 10 seeded rounds on every new path. Refuted if: 1,192 >= 28 us rented (no better than B's 29.5-30.8 within noise) with stamps showing the time is sync releases plus dependent rounds rather than removable phase work, or fewer than 2 of the 5 target rows beat the merge path by >= 2 us. Then the single-launch route for S rows is closed and B stays paused.
